name: Sharp
author: David J Wu (lightvector)
description: bot_Sharp, winner of the 2015 Arimaa Challenge. This build is a fork, not maintained or endorsed by its author.

options.name: hash
options.description: Hash table size in megabytes, rounded to a power of two; takes effect at the next search.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Log each finished iteration and new best move, with its principal variation.

options.name: ignoretc
options.description: Ignore the time control and search until stopped (or to the depth limit).

options.name: depth
options.description: Stop searching at this many steps (at least 4). The time control still applies unless ignoretc is set. 0 for no fixed depth.
